name: human-speak
description: Remove recognizable AI writing patterns while preserving the writer's meaning and personal voice.

interface.shortDescription: Make AI writing sound direct and human
interface.longDescription: Edit, audit, or draft writing without the canned phrases, fake insight, dramatic fragments, and filler that make AI-assisted copy sound generic. Human Speak protects the writer's meaning, vocabulary, cadence, humor, and useful imperfections.
defaultPrompt: Humanize this draft without flattening my voice.
Audit this copy for recognizable AI writing patterns.
Rewrite this so it sounds direct, specific, and natural.
